caseName: King v. United States District Court for the Central District of California
caseNameFull: King v. United States District Court for the Central District of California (Integrity Home Loan Co., Inc., Real Parties in Interest)

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 9th Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
